answer.reason: GLOSSARY.md names all five phases (reserved, guaranteed, in-house, departed, cancelled) and attaches the inn's own house rules to them, such as the 48-hour release, the no-show night charge and folio posting. The core branches on these rules in release-unpaid-rooms and stay.ts, so the domain owns these distinctions even though they line up one to one with RoomsHub's codes.
